Phases of days

Source: R/dayPhase.R
daysPhases.Rd

Phases of days

Usage

daysPhases(
  date = Sys.Date(),
  period = "year",
  plot = FALSE,
  lat = 50.1,
  lon = 1.83,
  tz = "UTC"
)

Arguments

date

A time object representing the start time of a recording

period

"month" or "year"

plot

If true plots the data, default FALSE

lat

Latitude of recording device

lon

Longitude of recording device

tz

Time-zone of recording device when recording was made

Value

A data frame with a row for each day, giving the times of each phase of the day and the state of the moon.

Examples

daysPhases(date=as.Date("2024-06-15"), period="month")
#>          Date  Lat  Lon           solarNoon               nadir
#> 1  2024-05-31 50.1 1.83 2024-05-31 11:51:52 2024-05-31 23:52:01
